在敌方下个回合结束前取胜，并保住蓝方母舰。: Win by the end of the next enemy turn and keep your mothership alive.
延迟伤害只有在你活到结算时才有价值。先消除对方的致命反击，再确保导弹中心准确覆盖: Delayed damage matters only if you survive to see it land. Remove the lethal reply, then center the missile on the enemy core.
R1 核心 3、主炮 1、引擎 0，已蓄力；B1 核心 4；B3 有导弹。对手会: R1: core 3, cannon 1, engine 0, charged. B1: core 4. B3 has missiles. The enemy chooses a reply that prevents your win if one exists.
只发导弹，对手就会抢先开炮。需要同时让自己的核心免于致命反击。: A missile alone lets the enemy fire first. Your own core must also be safe from a lethal reply.
一种方法是用 B2 拆主炮，用 B3 把导弹中心落在母舰核心；两次行动顺序均可。: One approach: B2 disables the cannon while B3 targets the mothership core with a missile. Either action order works.
B2 攻击 G9 · L3；B3 定点攻击 G11 · L3。也可让 B1 的核: B2 attacks G9 · L3; B3 targets G11 · L3. Alternatively, move B1's core out of the enemy beam and launch the missile. Valid alternative solutions count.
你同时安排了生存与击杀。拆掉敌炮或让自己的核心避开射线，都能争取到导弹结算的时间: You planned survival and a kill together. Disabling the enemy cannon or moving your core out of its beam buys time for the missile. This result survives every legal enemy reply.
要同时处理「对方下一步能杀我」与「我怎样杀对方」。检查致命反击是否已解除，以及导: Solve both questions: can the enemy kill me, and how do I kill it? Check that the lethal reply is stopped and the missile is centered on the core.
开局 B7 已在敌方武库舰射程内。先把神盾移到能覆盖它的位置，再用一次指挥行动展: B7 starts in enemy missile range. Move the Aegis into covering distance, then use one command action to develop all four fighters.
护盾池全队共享，不能当成每艘各有 3 点。前进后的高层 B11 也会进入导弹射程: The shield is one shared pool, not 3 points per ship. After advancing, high-altitude B11 enters missile range too. Be ready to dodge next turn.
神盾 B3 向东 2 格。B7 核心进入距离 2 的护盾范围。: Aegis B3 moves east 2 cells. B7's core enters the shield's distance-2 coverage.
指挥舰让四艘攻击艇向北 2 格。一次行动展开多个单位。: The command ship moves four fighters north 2 cells: several units developed with one action.
一种对手回应：用导弹锁定刚前进的高层 B11。开局计划仍要随威胁调整。: One possible reply: the enemy targets the newly advanced B11 with a missile. An opening plan must still adapt to threats.
对手也推进护卫舰。轮到你时，先考虑让攻击艇编队向东 2 格避弹，再决定另一项行动: The enemy advances its corvettes too. On your turn, consider moving the fighter group east 2 cells to dodge, then choose your other action.
展开护卫舰，迫使对手让位: Develop corvettes and force a response
两艘护卫舰分居两翼，用指挥舰统一前进，再以武库舰锁定暴露的敌方护卫舰，争取推进的: Your corvettes occupy opposite flanks. Advance them with the command ship, then use the arsenal to target an exposed enemy corvette and buy time.
导弹不是即时吃子。对手可以躲开，随后也可能反锁你的 B7；不要把无人命中的轰炸当: A missile is not an instant capture. The enemy can dodge and target your B7 in return. A bombardment that hits nothing is not automatically a gain.
两艘护卫舰向北推进 3 格，保留两翼路线。: Both corvettes advance north 3 cells, keeping both flanks open.
武库舰锁定 R7 核心 C11 · L3。若对手不处理，会吃到 3 点核心伤害。: The arsenal targets R7's core at C11 · L3. If ignored, it will take 3 core damage.
一种对手回应：R7 向东 3 格，导弹将落空，但它花掉了一次行动。: One possible reply: R7 moves east 3 cells. The missile misses, but the dodge costs an action.
对手反锁前进的 B7。下一回合先处理这枚导弹，不能机械照搬开局顺序。: The enemy targets your advancing B7. Deal with that missile next turn; do not follow an opening sequence mechanically.
先让处于导弹射程的 B7 撤到安全线外，再用武库舰迫使敌方 R7 调整位置。适合: Pull B7 out of missile range, then use your arsenal to force R7 to move. A useful plan for learning to check threats first.
你保住安全，却没有推进轻舰。对手可以利用另一项行动占据前沿；安全不是免费优势。: You gain safety without developing your light ships. The enemy can use its other action to take forward space. Safety has a cost.
B7 向南退 3 格。与敌方武库舰的曼哈顿距离从 9 增至 12，超出射程 10: B7 retreats south 3 cells. Its Manhattan distance from the enemy arsenal rises from 9 to 12, outside range 10.
锁定敌方 R7 核心，要求它用行动处理威胁。: Target R7's core and force it to spend an action on the threat.
一种对手回应：R7 躲开导弹。你没有直接造成伤害。: One possible reply: R7 dodges. You deal no direct damage.
对手利用另一项行动推进高层攻击艇。接下来应展开自己的轻舰，避免只守不发展。: The enemy uses its other action to advance a high-altitude fighter. Develop your light ships next; defending forever gives up space.
还剩一次行动。先确认另一艘舰该做什么；也可以主动结束回合。: One action remains. Decide what another ship should do, or end the turn early.
唯一主力舰。先蓄力，下个己方回合可沿舰首发射贯穿射线。移动或转向会取消蓄力。: Your only capital ship. Charge first, then fire a forward piercing beam on your next turn. Moving or rotating cancels the charge.
越过障碍锁定空间坐标。对手回合结束后引爆；中心伤害 3，六邻格伤害 1。四发备弹: Target a coordinate over obstacles. Detonates after the enemy turn: 3 center damage, 1 in six adjacent cells. Carries four missiles; reloading costs one action.
为核心周围曼哈顿距离 2 内的友军舱段吸收伤害。共享护盾池 3 点，每次己方回合: Absorbs damage to friendly modules within Manhattan distance 2 of its core. Its shared 3-point shield pool refills at the start of each friendly turn.
用一次行动让全场所有己方攻击艇或护卫舰同向同步移动。任何一艘受阻，整个指令不可执: Use one action to move all friendly fighters or corvettes in the same direction. A single blocked ship prevents the whole order.
固定设施，每 4 个己方回合生产 1 艘攻击艇。出港空间受阻或舰队达到 18 个: A fixed station that produces one fighter every 4 friendly turns. It waits if the launch area is blocked or 18 friendly units are alive.
两格舰身，可快速转移三格；射程三格，单次伤害一点。: A two-cell hull that moves up to 3 cells. Range 3, damage 1.
单格小艇，每次可移动四格。射程两格，依靠数量、掩护和包抄。: A single-cell craft that moves up to 4 cells. Range 2. Relies on numbers, cover and flanking.
每方回合可指挥两艘不同战舰，各行动一次。: Each turn, command two different ships with one action each.
超出射程或落点为小行星: Out of range or target is an asteroid

转向需要 90° 净空和完好引擎: Rotation requires 90° clearance and a working engine

围绕核心转向 90°，舰体扫过的方形区域需要净空。{0}: Rotate 90° around the core. The square swept by the hull must be clear. {0}

备弹 {0}/4 · 射程 10（曼哈顿距离）。中心伤害 3，六邻格伤害 1，包: Ammo {0}/4 · Range 10 (Manhattan distance). Damage: 3 at the center, 1 in six adjacent cells, including friendlies. Detonates after the enemy turn.
射程 {0} / 伤害 1。沿轴线、平面或空间对角线射击；小行星、星云和舰体会遮: Range {0} / Damage 1. Fires along axes, plane diagonals or space diagonals. Asteroids, nebulae and hulls block the shot.
连接超时，请检查网络后重试。: Connection timed out. Check your network and try again.
网络中断，请检查连接。: Network unavailable. Please check your connection.
目标在右前上方，既不在舰首轴线上，也不是等距对角线。主炮仍能瞄准它。: The target is ahead, to the right, and above. It is neither on the bow axis nor an equal diagonal, but the cannon can still aim at it.
不移动、不转向，用已蓄力的 B1 击毁 R2。: Destroy R2 with charged B1, without moving or rotating.
射界是以炮口为顶点、舰首为轴的 45°空间锥。选择目标确定一条直线；不是同时扫射: The muzzle is the tip of a 45° space cone around the bow axis. Choose a target to define one straight ray; the cannon does not fire across the whole cone.
B1 已蓄力；R2 是标准 2 点核心攻击艇。橙方母舰在练习区外。: B1 is charged. R2 is a standard fighter with 2 core HP. The orange mothership is outside the practice area.
先切到 L4，观察目标与炮口的高度差。: Switch to L4 and compare the heights of the target and muzzle.
点击 R2，或把主炮瞄准坐标设为 H9 · L4。: Click R2, or set the cannon aim to H9 · L4.
预览通往 H9 · L4 的射线，再确认。射线会穿过目标继续延伸。: Preview the ray through H9 · L4, then confirm. The beam continues beyond the target.
你在不转向、不取消蓄力的情况下完成了侧前方打击。45°限制的是方向，实际只发射这: You hit an off-axis target without rotating or losing charge. The 45° limit controls aim; only this one ray is fired.
先别移动或转向，那会丢掉蓄力。找出锥内的目标并预览射线。: Moving or rotating would lose your charge. Find the target inside the cone and preview its ray.
横移一格，还在炮口里: One sidestep is still in the cone
敌方主炮已就绪。B2 离开原来的直线，还不等于离开整个射界。: The enemy cannon is ready. Leaving its original line does not necessarily leave its whole firing cone.
让 B2 完整避开敌方下一回合的主炮，然后结束回合。: Move B2 clear of every enemy cannon shot next turn, then end your turn.
蓄力主炮即使不开火，也能限制对手的安全落点。封锁不是额外规则，而是对手必须考虑的: A charged cannon limits safe destinations even before it fires. Area denial is a consequence of a lethal threat, not an extra movement restriction.
R1 已蓄力；系统会寻找能击中 B2 的合法回应。B1 在练习区外。: R1 is charged. The defender searches for a legal reply that can hit B2. B1 is outside the practice area.
炮口在 G9 · L3，面向南方。橙色阴影显示当前高度的射界。: The muzzle is at G9 · L3, facing south. Orange shading shows coverage on the current layer.
向东一格、两格、三格都仍可能被瞄准；想想攻击艇的最大机动距离。: Moving east one, two, or three cells still leaves you vulnerable. Consider the fighter’s full movement range.
B2 向东 4 格到 K6 · L3，再结束回合。向西的安全撤离也可以。: Move B2 east 4 cells to K6 · L3, then end the turn. A safe withdrawal to the west also works.
你离开了整片射界，而不只是原来的瞄准线。这个落点能经受对手所有合法回应。: You left the entire firing cone, not just the old aim line. This destination survives every legal enemy reply.
敌方仍能重新瞄准 B2。比较炮口到落点的前向距离与侧向距离，别只躲原来的那条线。: The enemy can still aim at B2. Compare the forward and sideways distances from the muzzle; dodging the old line is not enough.
用护盾换一轮无伤反击: Trade shields for a free counterattack
神盾舰的近防炮伤害不高，但护盾可以吸收对方的还击。先打、承受反击，再收尾。: The Aegis gun is weak, but its shield can absorb retaliation. Shoot, absorb the reply, then finish the target.
用 B2 击毁 R2，并至少吸收一次反击，B2 核心保持 4。: Destroy R2 with B2 after absorbing at least one reply. Keep B2 at 4 core HP.
看交换是否划算，要算护盾和回合补充。护盾池只有 3 点，也保护发生器；持续集火仍: Count shields and turn-start replenishment when evaluating an exchange. The shared pool has only 3 points and also protects the generator; concentrated fire can exhaust it.
本课 R2 固定射击 B2 核心，随后结束回合。这是护盾机制演示，不代表对手在实: In this lesson R2 always shoots B2’s core, then ends its turn. This demonstrates the shield mechanic; a real opponent is free to retreat.
先用神盾的近防炮打掉 R2 一点核心。: Use the Aegis defensive gun to remove 1 HP from R2.
结束回合。观察战报：敌方反击被护盾吸收，自己的回合开始时护盾补回 3。: End your turn. The report shows the shield absorbing the reply; at the start of your next turn it refills to 3.
再次攻击 F8 · L3，击毁 R2。检查 B2 核心仍为 4。: Shoot F8 · L3 again to destroy R2. Check that B2 still has 4 core HP.
两炮击毁目标，自己的核心没有损伤。吸收反击和回合补盾让这次交换获利；别把护盾当成: Two shots destroyed the target without damaging your core. Absorption and replenishment made the exchange favorable; shields are not unlimited HP.
需要真实吸收一次反击，再完成击杀。留在两格射程内，按回合节奏使用近防炮。: You must actually absorb a reply before finishing the target. Stay within two-cell range and use the gun across successive turns.
两艘攻击艇同时被导弹锁定。逐个移动会耗完两次行动，指挥舰可以让它们一起撤离。: Two fighters are locked by missiles. Moving them individually uses both actions; the command ship can move them together.
用一次攻击艇联动避弹，结束回合后 B3、B4 都保持完整。: Use one fighter group move to evade. End the turn with B3 and B4 undamaged.
指挥舰把多艘轻舰的机动合并成一次行动。代价是所有参与者都算已行动，且任一路径被堵: A group order combines several light ships’ movement into one action. Every participant is marked as acted, and any blocked path prevents the entire order.
两枚导弹都在本回合结束时引爆。B2 是指挥舰，B3、B4 是攻击艇。: Both missiles land at the end of this turn. B2 is the command ship; B3 and B4 are fighters.
选 B2 的「技能」，联动舰型选攻击艇。: Select B2’s Ability tab and choose the fighter class.
距离至少两格，避开导弹中心和六个相邻格。: Move at least two cells to clear the centers and their six adjacent cells.
攻击艇向东联动 2 格，然后结束回合。移动后两艘艇都不能再单独开火。: Command the fighters east 2 cells, then end the turn. Neither fighter can fire separately after participating.
一次指令同时救下两艘轻舰，仍留下另一项行动的选择。参与编队的舰艇已经用过行动。: One order saved both fighters and preserved the option of another action. Every participating ship has already acted.
检查两艘攻击艇的落点：都要避开爆炸邻格，并且通过编队联动完成撤离。: Both fighters must clear the blast and adjacent cells, using a group move to withdraw.
让护盾跟上火力: Bring protection to the firing line
攻击艇能打到敌人，却还没进入护盾范围。用另一艘舰的行动，为它的攻击提供保护。: The fighter has a shot but is outside shield coverage. Use another ship’s action to protect its attack.
本回合让 B3 打伤 R2；敌方反击后 B3 仍是 2 点核心。: Damage R2 with B3 this turn. Keep B3 at 2 core HP after the reply.
两次行动可以分工：一艘创造保护条件，一艘制造伤害。护盾只看舱段到神盾核心的曼哈顿: Split the two actions: one ship creates protection, the other deals damage. Shield coverage uses Manhattan distance from the Aegis core to the protected module.
本课 R2 固定反击 B3 核心。B2 是神盾，B3 是攻击艇；这是交换机制练习: R2 always retaliates against B3’s core in this lesson. B2 is the Aegis and B3 is the fighter. This is a controlled exchange exercise.
B3 核心在 G5 · L3，当前离神盾核心三格，没有保护。: B3’s core is at G5 · L3, three cells from the Aegis core and currently unprotected.
把 B2 向西移动一格或两格，将 B3 纳入护盾距离 2。: Move B2 west one or two cells to bring B3 within shield radius 2.
再选 B3 攻击 G7 · L3。观察对方反击时护盾替 B3 承受伤害。: Select B3 and fire at G7 · L3. Watch the shield absorb the enemy reply.
神盾负责创造安全交换，攻击艇负责输出。对方损失一点核心，你的攻击艇完整。: The Aegis created a safe exchange and the fighter supplied the damage. The opponent lost 1 core HP; your fighter remains intact.
要同时造成伤害和保护 B3。神盾离得太远，或者把两次行动都花在机动上，都不能完成: You need both damage and protection. Keeping the Aegis too far away, or spending both actions on movement, cannot achieve the goal.
导弹逼走，主炮收网: Missiles drive them into the cannon
敌方核心在主炮射界外，但只剩一个可移动出口。用导弹迫使它进入已蓄力主炮的控制区。: The enemy core is outside your cannon cone, but it has only one movement exit. Use a missile to force it into the charged cannon’s coverage.
用定点导弹与主炮的配合，在下个己方回合内击毁 R1。: Combine a coordinate missile and the cannon to destroy R1 by the end of your next turn.
一种武器要求对手离开当前位置，另一种武器控制它的退路。先保留蓄力，等对手回应后再: One weapon demands that the opponent leave its square; another controls the escape route. Keep the charge and choose the shot after seeing the reply.
R1 核心剩 3；小行星使它只能向西机动。B1 已蓄力。系统检查敌方所有合法回应: R1 has 3 core HP. Asteroids leave only a westward move. B1 is charged. Every legal enemy reply is checked; the demonstration prefers an escape from the missile center.
先用 B2 锁定 I8 · L3。不要让 B1 移动、转向或浪费已蓄力的炮。: Target I8 · L3 with B2. Do not move, rotate, or waste B1’s charged shot.
结束回合。留在原地会被导弹击毁；向西撤离会进入主炮 45°射界。: End the turn. Staying is lethal; moving west enters the cannon’s 45° firing cone.
若敌方撤到 H8 · L3，选 B1 瞄准那里，预览并确认贯穿炮。: If R1 retreats to H8 · L3, aim B1 there, preview the ray, and confirm.
导弹逼对手离开原地，主炮控制退路。对手若不撤离会被炸毁，撤离后也无法逃过下一回合: The missile forced the move and the cannon covered the exit. Staying loses to the blast; retreating loses to the next cannon shot.
需要保留已就绪的主炮，同时把导弹中心放在敌方核心。过早开炮或移动母舰，会让对手从: Keep the charged cannon ready while centering the missile on the enemy core. Firing early or moving your mothership opens an escape.
阴影：本层主炮射界 · 实际命中看射线预览: Shading: cannon coverage on this layer · Preview the exact ray
母舰先蓄力，下个己方回合可发射；可在舰首前方 45°空间锥内瞄准一条直线，射程: Charge the mothership, then fire on your next turn. Aim one straight ray within a 45° cone around the bow: range 14, damage 4 per hit module, including friends. Asteroids stop it. Fighters move 4 with range 2; corvettes move 3 with range 3. Both deal 1 damage.
选择锥内任意格确定一条直线，贯穿至射程尽头。穿透舰体、残骸与星云，小行星截断；不: Aim at any cell in the cone to define one straight ray extending to full range. Hulls, wrecks and nebula do not stop it; asteroids do. It is not an area volley.
